Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.

  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.

Lightning AI is looking to hire AI Platform Support Engineers to join our EMEA Customer Experience team, supporting ML engineers running large-scale training and inference workloads across cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, and GPU platforms in production environments.

This role is not a ticket router or traditional support engineer. You are a technical partner to ML teams - helping diagnose failures, improve reliability, and guide customers through complex distributed systems problems.The problems range from Kubernetes scheduling and GPU orchestration to distributed PyTorch failures, inference latency, networking bottlenecks, storage performance, and platform reliability.   • Build internal tooling, automation, documentation, and runbooks
  • Partner closely with infrastructure, networking, and platform engineering teams
  • Help improve observability, operational visibility, and troubleshooting workflows
  • Improve the customer experience through better processes and technical guidance

What This Role Is Not

To set clear expectations:

  • This is not a traditional help desk or ticket routing support role
  • This is not purely customer success or account management
  • This is not a backend engineering role
  • This is not a passive escalation position

This role is for engineers who enjoy solving difficult technical problems while working closely with other engineers.

 

What You’ll Need

Required Qualifications

Infrastructure & Systems

  • Strong software engineering and systems troubleshooting background
  • Experience with Kubernetes and containerized environments
  • Linux systems knowledge, including networking, storage, process management, and performance tuning
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure and distributed systems
  • Experience with observability and debugging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry

ML Infrastructure Experience

  • Hands on experience operating machine learning workloads in production or research environments
  • Experience with distributed ML systems and tooling such as PyTorch, CUDA, or NCCL
  • Familiarity with GPU infrastructure and orchestration

  • Understanding of the operational challenges involved in running ML systems at scale

Collaboration

  • Comfortable operating in fast moving, highly ambiguous environments
  • Enjoys solving complex technical problems collaboratively

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with large scale model training or distributed inference systems
  • Familiarity with Ray, Kubeflow, Slurm, or similar distributed scheduling platforms
  • Experience with InfiniBand, RDMA, or high-performance networking
  • Experience operating bare metal infrastructure
  • Familiarity with storage systems commonly used in ML environments
  • Experience working at an AI infrastructure, cloud, MLOps, or developer tooling company
  • Contributions to platform engineering, developer infrastructure, or operational tooling projects
  • Experience writing automation, tooling, or scripts in Python or similar languages

Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Strong ability to understand varied stakeholder requirements, push back where needed, and translate them into generalised, well-documented models. Bonus: Experience modelling billing, subscription and ARR data (Stripe, Salesforce) or product event data at scale. Experience serving data to LLM-based agents or building semantic / metrics layers consumed by AI tools. Experience with CI for data (Slim CI, data contracts, PII policy tags) and infrastructure-as-code for warehouse access. Our partner is looking for an Artificial Intelligence (AI) Technician based in France. This is a remote opportunity for a technically skilled AI professional looking to make a tangible impact across business operations. You will research, implement, and optimize AI, automation, and data-driven technologies across multiple functions. The role combines AI/ML expertise with systems integration, process automation, analytics, and operational improvement. You will identify opportunities to streamline workflows, improve decision-making, and increase efficiency through technology. You will work with a diverse range of platforms spanning finance, accounting, labor management, forecasting, and business intelligence. Strong technical understanding of AI models, automation workflows, APIs, data flows, and business technology systems. Experience implementing or integrating business applications, ideally across finance, accounting, operations, workforce management, or related functions. Familiarity with tools such as Zapier, Make, Power BI, Looker Studio, or comparable automation and business intelligence platforms. Experience working with accounting, POS, forecasting, reconciliation, or bookkeeping systems is highly valuable. Ability to research emerging technologies, assess their practical applications, and translate business needs into effective technical solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on accuracy, scalability, and measurable outcomes. Ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues and continuously optimize AI and automation systems. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. title: Associate, Corporate Development

description:
This senior pharmaceutical and regulatory position acts as the trusted right-hand partner (“bras droit”) to the Responsible Pharmacist (RP)/Chief Pharmaceutical Officer (CPO). Working in very close collaboration with the RP/CPO, the role supports the oversight, coordination, and execution of the company’s pharmaceutical responsibilities in France and provides continuity of leadership by acting as Deputy Chief Pharmaceutical Officer when required.

The position combines regulatory affairs, pharmaceutical quality, pharmacovigilance, promotional compliance, product supply oversight, and healthcare compliance. It requires both strategic judgment and strong operational involvement to ensure that the activities of the pharmaceutical establishment—particularly those associated with the exploitant status—are conducted in accordance with French and European requirements.

As a true extension of the RP/CPO, the role is expected to anticipate issues, provide sound recommendations, coordinate sensitive matters, and take ownership of key activities. When deputising for the RP/CPO, the incumbent assumes the relevant pharmaceutical responsibilities associated with the missions set out in Article R.5124-36 of the French Public Health Code.

This position is hybrid (onsite and remote working) and will be primarily located at Alnylam France offices in Paris.

Key Responsibilities

  • Participate in cross-functional regulatory initiatives within the affiliate, integrating perspectives from Commercial, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Quality, Supply Chain, Pharmacovigilance, and other relevant functions as assigned
    • Facilitate effective collaboration between Regulatory, Medical, PV, Quality, and Commercial functions to identify and address potential compliance risks and ensure timely escalation and resolution of regulatory matters.
  • Provide regulatory guidance on product information, promotional and non-promotional materials, medical/scientific communications, and other company information concerning medicinal products, ensuring alignment with approved product information and applicable legal requirements.
    • Lead the regulatory review of promotional documents, as the non-promotional elements (institutional and environmental elements) to ensure that they are non-promotional working in partnership with internal groups and external Regulatory partners if necessary
  • Act as the local French regulatory lead for assigned products, if necessary (ensuring local execution of the global strategy related to centralized procedure presdcription products, and/or development activities related to clinical studies etc. as needed)
  • Regarding Pharmacovigilance activities, ensure local reconciliation activities, manage activities related to the approval of educational materials, and can act as LSO or LSO deputy
  • Collaborate with the Responsible Pharmacist (RP)/Chief Pharmaceutical Officer (CPO) in the treatment of quality defects and any alert relating to the quality of batches, leading to a batch recall/withdrawal if necessary
  • Contribute to the follow-up and processing of distribution/service complaints in concertation with the supply chain
  • Supervise the monitoring of supplies of marketed products to ensure appropriate and continuous supply
  • Contribute to the evaluation of product quality reviews (PQR) and ensure the follow-up of corrective and preventive measures described in the PQR and related to the performance of the manufacturing process and the storage conditions of the products
  • Manage the implementation of process reviews and the pharmaceutical quality management system (QMS) in order to respond to regulatory changes and contribute to the operations inherent to the business
  • Support activities regarding the Chart for promotional information, audit of subcontractors
  • Support activities regarding compliance or relations with Healthcare Professionals and anti-gift law
  • Build and maintain strong partnerships with external consultants, CROs, regulatory service providers, industry stakeholders, and relevant authorities to advance regulatory objectives and ensure appropriate local regulatory compliance.
  • As a Chief Pharmaceutical Officer Deputy, ensures compliance of the missions as described in art. R.5124-36 of the French Public Health Code when acting to replace the RP/CPO
  • Promote a culture of regulatory compliance, transparency, and responsible communication of medicinal-product information across the affiliate

Qualifications

Required

  • PharmD with relevant experience registered with “Ordre des Pharmaciens” (section B)
  • Extensive knowledge and at least 7 years of experience of country-specific French/European Regulatory requirements for innovative products in late-stage development and post-approval
  • Sound knowledge and experience of French and European Regulatory Affairs and associated requirements, specifically with prescription medicines and Centralized procedure
  • Prior relevant knowledge and experience related to the activities related to the “exploitant”
  • Established knowledge and at least 5 years of experience in promotional activities and capabilities to intecact with the medical affairs and marketing/commercial teams, as well as the French Competent Authorities
  • Experience with working closely with ANSM and an excellent track record of building relationships with and influencing Regulatory Agencies
  • Must be able and willing to work in a high-visibility, fast-paced environment. Must be flexible, detail-oriented, and possess good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Role entails particularly close and continuous collaboration with the RP/CPO, built on trust, transparency, responsiveness, and a shared understanding of priorities and risks.

Preferred

  • Solid knowledge and at least 3 years of experience of country-specific French/European Regulatory requirements for pharmacovigilance
  • Knowledge of the compassionate use programs and releated regulatory requirements in France
  • Experience in Quality Assurance and QA operational activities (e.g. managing deviations, changes, complaints, issues, recalls etc.), in managing third parties including auditing and contract management, in managing inspections by competent authorities

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team Partner Flow owns the journey for small businesses that come to iwoca through a partner platform, from how they discover iwoca’s business finance to any repeat lending. The aim is to reach each business at the right time, make it easy to apply and get funded, and match them with the offer that suits them and works best for iwoca over time. The team works on three parts of that journey: The application. Making it smooth and collecting the data a credit decision needs. Routing. You'll work out what the business needs, reason from first principles, weigh the trade-offs, and shape the project with product, commercial, and strategy colleagues before deciding how it gets done. description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enterprise Account Executive at Anthropic, you'll join the foundational team at the forefront of introducing our cutting-edge AI productivity API and SaaS solutions to financial institutions across the EMEA markets. You'll drive the adoption of safe, frontier AI by securing strategic deals with banks, insurance companies, and financial research institutions. You'll leverage your consultative sales expertise in the financial services sector to propel revenue growth while becoming a trusted partner to financial stakeholders, helping them embed and deploy AI while uncovering its full range of capabilities in banking, research, and administration. In collaboration with GTM, Product, and Marketing teams, you'll continuously refine our value proposition, sales methodology, and market positioning to resonate with financial decision-makers.

The ideal candidate will have a passion for developing new market segments, pinpointing high-potential opportunities, and executing strategies to capture them. By driving deployment of Anthropic's emerging products, you will help enterprises obtain new capabilities while also advancing the ethical development of AI.

Responsibilities:

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Anthropic within the financial services sector. Navigate complex financial institutions to reach key decision-makers, educate them about our services, and help them succeed with Anthropic. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first outbound to close
  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies tailored to financial services procurement cycles and budgeting processes to meet and exceed revenue quotas. Analyze financial market landscapes, trends, and dynamics to translate high-level plans into targeted sales activities and campaigns
  • Spearhead market expansion by identifying new use cases within financial departments, research centers, and administrative offices. Collaborate cross-functionally to differentiate our offerings for financial applications
  • Navigate complex financial stakeholder ecosystems including executives, administrators, IT departments, and procurement offices to build consensus
  • Inform product roadmaps and features by gathering feedback from financial users and conveying financial market needs. Provide insights that strengthen our value proposition for financial services
  • Continuously refine the financial services sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices. Identify process improvements that optimize sales productivity and consistency

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 12+ years of B2B sales experience in financial services technology in SaaS, API solutions, or emerging technologies
  • A track record of managing complex sales cycles within financial institutions and securing strategic deals by understanding both technical requirements and financial use cases
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate financial bureaucracies and procurement processes, building consensus among diverse stakeholders including executives, administrators, and IT departments 
  • Extensive experience negotiating complex agreements within financial services procurement frameworks and policies
  • Proven experience exceeding revenue targets in the financial services sector by effectively managing an evolving pipeline and sales process
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to present confidently to various financial audiences, from analysts and researchers to senior executives
  • Deep understanding of financial services buying cycles, decision-making processes, and key pain points
  • A strategic, analytical approach to assessing the financial services market combined with creative, tactical execution to capture opportunities
  • A passion for and/or experience with advanced AI systems and their applications in financial services. You feel strongly about ensuring frontier AI systems are developed safely and ethically for financial use

 

À propos du poste

En tant qu'Enterprise Account Executive chez Anthropic, vous rejoindrez l'équipe fondatrice chargée de faire découvrir notre API de productivité IA de pointe et nos solutions SaaS aux institutions financières des marchés EMEA. Vous favoriserez l'adoption d'une IA de pointe et sûre en concluant des contrats stratégiques avec des banques, des compagnies d'assurance et des instituts de recherche financière. Vous mettrez à profit votre expertise de la vente consultative dans les services financiers pour accélérer la croissance du chiffre d'affaires. Vous nouerez aussi des relations de confiance avec les parties prenantes du secteur financier et les aiderez à intégrer et à déployer l'IA, tout en leur faisant découvrir l'étendue de ses capacités dans la banque, la recherche et l'administration. En collaboration avec les équipes GTM, Produit et Marketing, vous affinerez en continu notre proposition de valeur, notre méthodologie de vente et notre positionnement, afin qu'ils trouvent un écho auprès des instances décisionnelles du secteur financier.

Le profil idéal a à cœur de développer de nouveaux segments de marché, de repérer les opportunités à fort potentiel et de mettre en œuvre les stratégies qui permettent de les saisir. En favorisant le déploiement des produits émergents d'Anthropic, vous aiderez les entreprises à acquérir de nouvelles capacités tout en contribuant au développement éthique de l'IA.

Responsabilités :

  • Remporter de nouveaux contrats et générer du chiffre d'affaires pour Anthropic dans le secteur des services financiers. Vous orienter au sein d'institutions financières complexes pour atteindre les personnes décisionnaires clés, leur présenter nos services et les aider à réussir avec Anthropic. Vous piloterez l'intégralité du cycle de vente, de la première prise de contact à la signature.
  • Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des stratégies commerciales innovantes, adaptées aux cycles d'achat et aux processus budgétaires des services financiers, afin d'atteindre et de dépasser les objectifs de chiffre d'affaires. Analyser le paysage, les tendances et les dynamiques des marchés financiers pour traduire les plans stratégiques en actions et campagnes commerciales ciblées.
  • Piloter l'expansion sur le marché en identifiant de nouveaux cas d'usage au sein des directions financières, des centres de recherche et des services administratifs. Collaborer de manière transverse pour différencier nos offres destinées aux applications financières.
  • Naviguer dans des écosystèmes complexes de parties prenantes (direction générale, services administratifs, DSI et services achats) afin de construire un consensus.
  • Contribuer à la feuille de route et aux fonctionnalités produit en recueillant les retours des équipes utilisatrices du secteur financier et en relayant les besoins du marché. Apporter des éclairages qui renforcent notre proposition de valeur pour les services financiers.
  • Affiner en continu la méthodologie de vente dédiée aux services financiers en intégrant les enseignements dans des playbooks, des modèles et des bonnes pratiques. Identifier des améliorations de processus qui optimisent la productivité et la cohérence commerciales.

Ce poste pourrait vous correspondre si vous avez :

  • Au moins 12 ans d'expérience en vente B2B dans les technologies pour les services financiers (SaaS, solutions API ou technologies émergentes)
  • Une solide expérience de la gestion de cycles de vente complexes au sein d'institutions financières et de la conclusion de contrats stratégiques, fondée sur une compréhension fine des exigences techniques comme des cas d'usage financiers
  • Une capacité avérée à naviguer dans les structures bureaucratiques et les processus d'achat du secteur financier, en construisant un consensus entre des parties prenantes variées, dont la direction, les services administratifs et les DSI
  • Une vaste expérience de la négociation d'accords complexes dans le cadre des politiques et procédures d'achat des services financiers
  • Une expérience confirmée du dépassement des objectifs de chiffre d'affaires dans les services financiers, grâce à une gestion efficace d'un pipeline et d'un processus de vente en constante évolution
  • D'excellentes compétences en communication et l'aisance nécessaire pour présenter devant des publics financiers variés, des analystes et des équipes de recherche jusqu'aux membres de la direction
  • Une connaissance approfondie des cycles d'achat, des processus de décision et des principales problématiques du secteur des services financiers
  • Une approche stratégique et analytique du marché des services financiers, alliée à une exécution tactique et créative pour saisir les opportunités
  • Un intérêt marqué pour les systèmes d'IA avancés et leurs applications dans les services financiers, voire une expérience dans ce domaine. Le développement sûr et éthique des systèmes d'IA de pointe pour les usages financiers vous tient particulièrement à cœur.

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

description: Qui sommes-nous ? N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, notre solution N2F s’impose comme la référence sur le marché français. N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile). Nous recherchons un.e Graphiste Confirmé(e) pour faire évoluer notre identité visuelle, la faire vivre sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et faire de notre site web une vitrine attractive. Tu intégreras l'équipe Communication et travailleras au quotidien avec les équipes Sales, RH, Product, la Direction ainsi qu'avec nos prestataires externes. Tu auras pour mission de : Faire évoluer notre identité visuelle sur l'ensemble de nos supports, produits et marchés, et en garantir la cohérence au quotidien. Concevoir les créations de nos campagnes marketing : publicités, réseaux sociaux, emails, lancements produits et communications clients. Rendre accessibles des sujets complexes (gestion des dépenses, finance, conformité, IA) grâce à des illustrations, infographies, schémas et vidéos. Créer nos supports commerciaux et institutionnels : présentations, brochures, fiches produits, témoignages clients, documents corporate. Produire les supports événementiels, de communication interne et de marque employeur : stands, signalétique, visuels, publications. Construire une bibliothèque de modèles et de composants réutilisables pour faciliter le travail des équipes et garantir la qualité des productions. Piloter le design et les évolutions courantes de notre site web (cohérence visuelle, parcours, landing pages, intégration de contenus), en lien avec l'agence qui gère la partie technique, et documenter composants et process. Mener tes projets du brief à la livraison, dans le respect des délais et des contraintes de production digitale et print. Ce qu'on va attendre de toi : Tu as environ 5 ans d'expérience en tant que graphiste dans un environnement B2B SaaS ou tech, en entreprise ou en agence auprès de clients B2B SaaS. Tu maîtrises Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign et Figma, ainsi que les fondamentaux : typographie, composition, couleur, hiérarchie de l'information. Tu as conçu des campagnes multicanales et tu connais les contraintes du digital comme du print. Tu as une expérience pratique d'un CMS (création de pages, intégration de contenus, responsive) et une bonne compréhension des principes UX/UI, d'accessibilité et de conversion. Tu utilises les outils de création assistée par l'IA avec pertinence, en gardant un regard exigeant sur la qualité, l'originalité et les droits d'utilisation. description:
Lead Software Engineer

Reports to: Director of Engineering

Department: Engineering

 

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a Lead Software Engineer to help lead a cryptographic software IP team. As a Lead Software Engineer, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire software development lifecycle, from design to testing, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions. This includes planning, organizing, and managing the software development, including setting timelines, allocating resources, and tracking progress. You will work across a variety of environments, solving complex problems and developing other engineers, while maintaining a strong focus on quality and best practices. You will support the hiring, training, and managing of a team of software engineers, fostering collaboration, and resolving conflicts.

Candidates should hold a degree in Electronic Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience, backed by at least 10 years in software design and/or verification. We are looking for a technical lead—or a senior engineer ready to step up into leadership—to guide our team. Knowledge of cryptographic engineering and side-channel attack resistance is a major bonus. You should be ready to contribute to cross-team strategy, lead architectural reviews, and drive planning for your team.

Founded in 2018, we are a well-funded deep tech startup with proven technology and a clear path to market. Joining us now offers a unique opportunity to work directly with our founders and inventors, fast-track your career progression, and shape a rapidly expanding segment of the semiconductor industry (Post-Quantum Cryptography and RISC-V). This is a great opportunity  for career progression and to get a head start in a rapidly expanding segment of the semiconductor industry (Post-Quantum Cryptography and RISC-V).

 

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

  • Working with other engineering leaders and project managers to plan and allocate work, ensuring we are delivering on our product roadmap.
  • You’ll be expected to take on a technical leadership role, and be responsible for coordinating and delivering application and embedded software IP design projects from conception to customer delivery.
  • Line Management of a software engineering team:
    • Identifying hiring needs, conducting interviews, and selecting suitable candidates for open positions.
    • Orienting new colleagues, providing necessary training, and ensuring they have the tools and knowledge to succeed.
    • Setting clear expectations, providing regular feedback, conducting performance reviews, and recognising and rewarding achievements.
    • Identifying training and development opportunities to help colleagues grow their skills and advance their careers.
    • Addressing under-performance, providing coaching and support, and taking disciplinary action when necessary.
    • Fostering positive relationships with team members, resolving conflicts, and promoting a positive work environment
  • Ensuring the software engineering team has all of the tooling and infrastructure it needs to function well.
  • Mentoring other colleagues, and being a point of contact for software design expertise within the company.
  • Working with verification engineers to review verification and test plans.
  • Define architectural definitions for complex algorithmic and/or system level solutions.
  • Providing feedback to colleagues on feasibility of implementation and specification quality.
  • Working closely with other teams and project stakeholders, and acting as an enabler for their development work. E.g. coordinating with hardware engineers or our product vulnerability team.
  • Engaging with customers, including helping with integration questions, or answering questions during technical sales calls.
  • Ensuring clean lint and implementation reports for IP blocks and subsystems.

 

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Confidence in planning out a project development cycle and coordinating with project managers as development progresses.
  • A commitment to high quality engineering in all areas of their work, including advocating for the best long-term solutions over the easiest or quickest.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with and inspire a team.
  • Experience building software IP blocks from scratch, and owning the process from initial specification through to customer delivery.
  • Expert level C experience in an embedded environment.
  • Able to apply knowledge effectively in unfamiliar situations and actively maintains own knowledge and shares with others.
  • Rapidly absorbs and critically assesses new information and applies it effectively.
  • Specifies architectural solutions to technical challenges across multiple technical domains.
  • Understanding of cryptographic algorithms, protocols, and key management systems.

 

👍 Preferred Skills And Qualifications

  • Familiarity with PQC standards and protocols (e.g., NIST PQC).
  • Familiarity with Rust in an Embedded environment.
  • Previous experience with software/hardware co-designs.
  • Arm & RISC-V experience.
  • Knowledge of side-channel security countermeasures.
  • Confidence using Gitlab CI, or otherwise principles of continuous integration and testing.
  • Confidence with the Python programming language.
  • Previous experience managing a cross-functional software team successfully.

 

🏆 Some of the perks of working with us:

  • Unparalleled opportunities to learn and accelerated career development.
  • A collaborative, team environment with people who truly love what they do.
  • Competitive salary and share option scheme.
  • Flexible and hybrid working, and a working from home budget.
  • Private health insurance for yourself and your family.
  • 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays and two wellness weeks).
  • 50% gym membership discount.
  • The chance to work with a spirited, smart, and friendly team!


PQShield is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We’re passionate about talent and proud to foster an inclusive environment; all applicants will be considered regardless of their gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability, and age.

description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. You will specialize in developing and optimizing large language models (LLMs), agentic AI, and deep learning frameworks to solve open problems in the natural sciences: Biology, Chemistry, Physics, and/or Materials Science. Your work will empower scientists with cutting-edge AI tools and accelerate research through: Model-centric innovation: Improving LLMs’ capabilities to tackle complex scientific problems (e.g., literature synthesis, autonomous experimentation, rigorous derivations). Cross-disciplinary collaboration: Partnering with Natural sciences domain experts to translate AI advancements into real-world scientific impact. Data creation: Design original workflows to accumulate high quality scientific data at scale, either through synthetic or crowd sourced pipelines. Algorithm Design: Use and improve reinforcement learning, or agentic systems tailored to Natural sciences challenges (e.g., modeling resolution, material property prediction, advanced data analysis and coding). Interdisciplinary Bridge: Work closely with domain scientists to identify AI opportunities and refine models based on feedback. Tooling & Infrastructure: Contribute to company infrastructure to improve usability for model training in scientific contexts and open-source AI tools for science for non-AI experts. Autonomous Innovation: Set a research agenda for AI in science, exploring high-risk/high-reward ideas. What We're Are Looking For AI/ML Expertise: Strong background in LLMs, deep learning, or agentic AI, with a track record of applying these to real-world problems (publications, open-source contributions, or deployed systems) – at the minimum extensive experience in computer science and ideally experience scaling synthetic data generation. State-of-the-art Knowledge: Familiarity with the latest advancements in LLM architectures and post training. Technical Depth: Hands-on experience with PyTorch/TensorFlow/JAX, model optimization, and scaling techniques (e.g., fine-tuning, RLHF). Scientific Capability: Ability to understand 1 Natural Science domain at a high level (e.g., graduate level specialization + general undergrad knowledge) to design effective AI solutions. Engineering Rigor: Proficiency in scientific computing (e.g., numerical methods, HPC) and software best practices. description:
About the Position

Our goals are to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street as a Machine Learning Researcher while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. You'll work side by side with experienced ML Researchers on projects that we've selected for their combination of novel ML ideas and relevance to real-world systematic trading strategies. You'll learn how we think about markets through challenging classes and activities, and practice using established methods alongside our own unique twists to train practical models.

At Jane Street, the lines between research, technology, and trading are intentionally blurry, and you’ll have access to petabytes of data, a computing cluster with hundreds of thousands of cores, and a growing GPU cluster containing tens of thousands of high-end GPUs. Trading poses unusual challenges—large models and nonstationary datasets in a competitive multi-agent environment—that force us to search for novel techniques.

You'll spend the bulk of your internship working closely with full-time machine learning researchers on projects drawn from their own work. You might conduct an end-to-end study of an unexplored dataset, try a new modelling paradigm for a thorny problem, or consider blue-sky approaches that we're still trying to figure out. The problems we work on rarely have clean, definitive answers, and they often require insights from colleagues across the firm with different areas of expertise. Depending on the day, you might be diving deep into market data, tuning hyperparameters, debugging training issues, or analysing the predictions your model makes.

Note that given the IP-sensitive nature of machine learning research at Jane Street, it is unlikely that any research findings associated with the internship will be suitable for outside academic publication.

About you

If you've never thought about a career in finance, you're in good company. Many of us were in the same position before working here. If you have a curious mind and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

  • An undergraduate, PhD student, or postdoc with practical experience working on ML problems
  • Interested in applying logical and mathematical thinking to all kinds of problems
  • Curious about the machine learning landscape and excited to apply state-of-the-art techniques drawn from many problem domains
  • Fluent with a versatile set of models and tricks
  • Able to rapidly implement and iterate on your ideas in Python and your favourite ML framework
  • Eager to ask questions, admit mistakes, and learn new things
  • Fluent in English

If you'd like to learn more, you can read about our interview process and meet some of the team. Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here.

description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Role overview: North is Cohere’s AI workspace platform for enterprises: a secure, customizable environment where companies can use AI across their real workflows while maintaining control over sensitive data. North connects AI agents with workplace tools, applications, and business context, helping users delegate complex work, build automations, inspect outputs, and collaborate with AI in production environments. As North becomes more capable, one of the most important questions is also one of the hardest: how do we know whether the model is actually getting better for the workflows customers care about? This role is about being the voice of North inside modelling. You will build the evaluation systems, feedback loops, and applied modelling workflows that make sure model progress translates into better product outcomes for North users. You will work closely with North product teams, customer-facing teams, and modelling teams to define what “good” means across the product surface, turn real usage and product direction into high-quality evals, and use those evals to guide model selection, patches, and regular model updates. This is neither a pure research role nor a conventional product engineering role. It is a rigorous applied MLE role for someone who cares deeply about measurement, model behavior, and real-world product quality. You should be excited by the craft of building careful evals: evals that capture messy agentic workflows, reflect actual customer needs, resist superficial benchmark hacking, and provide useful signal for where the product and models need to go next. Please note: this team works closely across Europe and East Coast North America time zones. We are open to candidates who can collaborate effectively within those hours. Key responsibilities: Own the eval strategy for North: define what we need to measure across agent workflows, tool use, enterprise knowledge work such as deep research, document creation or editing, and other human-AI interactions. Build high-quality evals from the realities of the product: user feedback, production failures, privacy-preserving usage logs, internal dogfooding, customer needs, and forward-looking product goals. Create systems that continuously turn what North is learning from users, customers, and feature teams into evals, so measurement keeps pace with the product rather than becoming a static benchmark. Be the voice of North inside modelling: extract clear insight from eval results, customer-derived data and product context, then turn model failures, capability gaps, and North-specific needs into actionable recommendations for the central modelling teams. Qualifications: You have improved LLM-powered, agent-powered, or AI-product systems through evals, feedback loops, data curation, prompting, model adaptation, or model selection. You care deeply about evaluation as a craft: representative tasks, precise rubrics, clean data, failure analysis, regression tracking, and knowing when a metric is giving false confidence. You have strong applied MLE judgment and can reason clearly about model behavior, eval validity, product outcomes, and production tradeoffs. You are comfortable working close to users and product teams, while translating messy qualitative signals into measurement that other modelling teams can act on. You are self-directed, practical, and motivated by open-ended problems where the right answer requires both technical depth and product understanding. You care about making AI systems genuinely useful in real enterprise settings, not just better on abstract benchmarks. If some of the above does not line up perfectly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. How and Where We Work: Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. About WPP Production

We are WPP Production - the unified global production company that brings together all of WPP's content producers, studios and craft experts into one connected organisation. We combine world-class human craft with next generation technology to originate, design, and deliver multi-channel content systems at scale. Built for borderless collaboration and powered by deep craft expertise, we are the production engine designed for today's always on, AI driven marketing world.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

A Hybrid working model

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

What does a AI Producer do at WPP Production?

We are looking for an AI Producer to support the delivery of innovative, technology-enabled content and campaigns across multiple channels and formats. This role is ideal for a producer with agency or production-house experience who is curious about emerging AI workflows and excited to help shape the future of creative production.

The AI Producer will manage projects end-to-end while collaborating with creative, strategy, production, motion, CGI, OOH, and technology teams to deliver high-quality work on time and on budget. The role requires a strong understanding of integrated production workflows, emerging AI tools, and the operational and legal considerations involved in modern content creation.

The successful candidate will be highly organised, solutions-oriented, eager to learn, and passionate about production, technology, and creativity.

Key Areas of Responsibility

Communication

  • Act as a key day-to-day contact for clients, agency partners, and internal stakeholders across projects
  • Support communication between creative, production, AI, CGI, motion, and post-production teams
  • Ensure project timelines, deliverables, and priorities are clearly communicated to all stakeholders
  • Maintain awareness of client satisfaction and proactively escalate risks or concerns
  • Help guide conversations around AI-enabled workflows and production efficiencies

Collaboration

  • Work collaboratively with interdisciplinary teams including creatives, strategists, technologists, editors, motion designers, CGI artists, and external vendors
  • Foster strong working relationships across local and global production teams
  • Support and mentor junior team members where appropriate
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative, and solutions-focused production culture

Process

  • Manage medium- to large-scale integrated production projects from briefing through delivery
  • Support productions across AI-led content creation
  • Coordinate schedules, budgets, approvals, assets, deliverables, and production workflows across multiple projects simultaneously
  • Help evaluate and implement AI tools and workflows within production pipelines
  • Maintain clear documentation including timelines, trackers, meeting notes, status reports, and risk management
  • Ensure projects are delivered on brief, on brand, on time, and on budget

Financial Management

  • Assist with project scoping, budgeting, estimates, and reconciliations
  • Track project costs, vendor management, POs, billing, and financial reporting
  • Partner with production, finance, and operations teams to ensure commercial accuracy and efficiency
  • Support cost-effective production solutions while maintaining creative quality

Legal & Compliance Awareness

  • Maintain a basic understanding of legal, compliance, and usage considerations related to AI-generated content and production workflows
  • Support adherence to licensing, talent usage, rights management, and content governance requirements
  • Ensure production processes align with client, platform, and company compliance standards
  • Escalate legal or compliance concerns to relevant teams when needed

 

Day-to-Day Responsibilities May Include

  • Developing and maintaining project scopes, timelines, and budgets
  • Coordinating with WPP Production’s global production network to support integrated campaign launches
  • Managing day-to-day communication with clients, agencies, suppliers, and internal teams
  • Supporting productions involving AI-generated content
  • Liaising with vendors and partners to obtain briefs, schedules, assets, and technical specifications
  • Managing trackers, reporting documents, and workflow systems
  • Assisting with production operations, resourcing, and traffic coordination
  • Supporting safe innovation and experimentation with new production technologies and AI tools

 

Requirements

  • 3–5+ years of production experience within an integrated agency, creative agency, production company, or studio environment
  • Experience working across integrated content production including OOH, CGI, motion, film, digital, and social content
  • Basic understanding of AI tools, AI-assisted creative workflows, and emerging production technologies
  • Strong knowledge of production and post-production processes from brief through final delivery
  • Understanding of asset management, formats, usage rights, and content delivery specifications
  • Awareness of legal and compliance considerations related to production and AI-generated content
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in fast-paced environments
  • Strong communication, organisation, and problem-solving skills
  • Proven ability to deliver projects on time and within budget
  • Natural problem solver and passion for innovation

At WPP Production, you’ll help shape the future of content production at a truly global scale. description:
Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)

The opportunity

Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly 3,000 people work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.

More than 500,000 healthcare professionals use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately 90 million people across Europe.

For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an AI-powered Health Companion that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.

This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.

We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.

What you will build and lead

As Product Design Director, Patient, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. 

Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:

  • access to care, search and booking;
  • patient messaging and teleconsultation;
  • the Patient Health Record and patient context;
  • the app homepage and daily health experience;
  • health content and prevention;
  • recommendations, reminders and care plans;
  • new patient services and subscription experiences;
  • conversational and AI-powered experiences.

The current team includes six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.

Your mandate

You will:

  • Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.
  • Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.
  • Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.
  • Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.
  • Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.
  • Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.
  • Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.
  • Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.
  • Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.
  • Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.

What success looks like

In your first year, you will have:

  • established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;
  • raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;
  • helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;
  • strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;
  • developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;
  • helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.

What we are looking for

You are likely to bring:

  • Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..
  • Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.
  • A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.
  • Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.
  • Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.
  • Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.
  • A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.
  • Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.
  • The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.
  • A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.
  • Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.
  • Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.
  • A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.

Why Doctolib, why now?

Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.

The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.

You will join at a defining moment:

  • Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.
  • AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.
  • The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.
  • The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.
  • The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.

This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of consumer product design, healthcare and AI, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.

 

Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. If you have a disability, please let us know how we can make the recruitment process more accessible.

Location: UK, France, Netherlands, Belgium, Germany, Austria, Spain, Finland, USA. Some travel to our offices will be required from time-to-time

Reports to: Chief Commercial Officer

 

💼 About the role

PQShield is looking for a Product Marketing Director who can turn complex technology into stories that people understand, remember, and act on.

You will own how PQShield's products, technology, and vision are positioned, communicated, and brought to market worldwide. You'll sit at the intersection of product, engineering, sales, customers, and the broader security market — translating breakthrough cryptography and security technology into compelling narratives for executives, engineers, partners, and buyers.

This role is for a strategic product marketer and exceptional storyteller who can identify the market shift, understand the customer problem, and turn complex technology into differentiated positioning that creates urgency, preference and demand. 

Since NIST published its first post-quantum cryptography (PQC) standards, which the PQShield team co-authored, organizations across semiconductors, automotive, defense, and enterprise face significant challenges in preparing for the post-quantum transition. This role will help define the market narrative around that transition, position PQShield's portfolio within it and give customers a clear reason to act.

 

⚒️ What you’ll be doing

  • Own the story: Develop the narrative, positioning, messaging, and value propositions that explain what is changing in the market, why customers need to act, the problem PQShield solves, and why our approach is differentiated.
  • Turn technical capability into customer value: Work with cryptographers, engineers and product leaders to understand sophisticated technology, identify what matters to the buyer and translate technical capabilities into clear business and security value without sacrificing technical credibility.
  • Position the portfolio: Own positioning and messaging for our hardware IP and software portfolio, including PQPlatform, PQPerform, PQCryptoLib, and PQMicroLib. Build a clear messaging architecture that connects the portfolio while preserving the differentiated value of each offering.
  • Understand the customer: Develop deep insight into customer problems, buying journeys, security requirements, regulatory pressures, barriers to adoption, buying dynamics, and the forces driving post-quantum adoption. Turn those insights into sharper products, messaging, and go-to-market strategies.
  • Shape category and market narrative: Help define how PQShield talks about post-quantum security, cryptographic agility, and the transition to quantum-safe systems — and how we differentiate our approach in a rapidly evolving market.
  • Lead product launches: Create and execute compelling go-to-market strategies for new products, certifications, partnerships, and major releases.
  • Equip the sales team: Build compelling presentations, stories, solution briefs, case studies, battlecards, and other tools that help sales teams communicate value and win complex deals.
  • Build buyer and segment-specific stories: Develop differentiated narratives for semiconductors, automotive, military and aerospace, industrial IoT, networking, and enterprise, adapting the value story for different buyers, use cases and business priorities.
  • Own competitive storytelling: Understand the competitive landscape and turn technical and commercial differences into clear, credible differentiation.
  • Create exceptional content: Lead the development of white papers, thought leadership, application notes, customer stories, executive content, web experiences, and other material that establishes PQShield as a category leader.
  • Bring customer stories to life: Find and develop the stories that demonstrate why customers are making the transition to post-quantum security and why they choose PQShield.
  • Work across the company: Partner closely with product, engineering, sales, partnerships, and leadership to ensure the market sees one clear, compelling PQShield story.

 

🎯 Required Skills And Qualifications

We're looking for an experienced product marketing leader who is exceptionally strong in positioning, messaging and strategic storytelling. You can take an emerging market, complicated buyer problem or deeply technical product and find the clear narrative inside it.

  • 8+ years of marketing experience, with significant experience in product marketing, technology marketing, B2B marketing, or a closely related discipline.
  • A proven ability to develop positioning and stories that change how markets understand a product, technology, or company.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills. You can take something highly technical and make it understandable, interesting, and compelling without dumbing it down.
  • Strong storytelling instincts and the ability to find the human, business, and strategic narrative inside complex technology.
  • Experience marketing technical B2B products, ideally in cybersecurity, semiconductors, infrastructure, embedded systems, software, or another sophisticated technology market.
  • Strong understanding of security and technology buyers, and the ability to communicate credibly with CISOs, CTOs, engineers, architects, product leaders, and business executives.
  • Demonstrated ability to work closely with technical experts and quickly develop enough subject-matter expertise to challenge assumptions, ask good questions, and tell an accurate story.
  • A strong commercial mindset: you understand that great marketing isn't just about explaining a product — it's about creating differentiation, urgency, preference, and ultimately revenue.
  • Experience launching products and taking complex offerings to market.
  • Experience developing compelling sales narratives and enablement for complex, multi-stakeholder sales.
  • Excellent strategic judgment, with the ability to determine what the market needs to hear, why it matters, and how PQShield should say it.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where you will often need to create the narrative before the market has established one.

 

What we can offer you

  • A competitive compensation package.
  • Share options.
  • A remote first company. You will work from home most of the time, but will need to join us in the office for planning sessions and key meetings as required.
  • Travel for customer meetings and marketing events as needed. 
  • Health insurance.
  • Generous PTO and holiday package.
  • Company contributions towards 401K/pension
  • …and other great benefits.

 

If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value the security of our daily digital lives, and love solving hard problems - then we’d love to hear from you.

description:
Contexte :

Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.

L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).

Présentation d’Artefact :

Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée  en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit  de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.

Sujet :

Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.


Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.


Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.

Pré-requis

Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :
BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur
Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études
Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027
Durée : 4 à 6 mois

Références

  1. Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision, 64(6), 672-689.
  2. Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency (pp. 77-91). PMLR.
  3. Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.
  4. Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. CoRR abs/2308.02935.
  5. Thong, W., Joniak, P., & Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In 2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV) (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.
  6. Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., & Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings (pp. 5344-5351).
  7. Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., & El Karoui, N. (2019, May). Fairness-aware learning for continuous attributes and treatments. In International conference on machine learning(pp. 4382-4391). PMLR.
  8. Giuliani, L., Misino, E., & Lombardi, M. (2023, July). Generalized disparate impact for configurable fairness solutions in ML. In International Conference on Machine Learning (pp. 11443-11458). PMLR.

description:
Hudson River Trading (HRT) is seeking a Research Data Expert to join our Data team. Data is a cornerstone of HRT’s trading strategies, serving as the raw fuel that powers research, automated trading, and risk management.

In this role, you will own a specific area of expertise, working on sourcing junior data engineers, platform engineers, and alpha researchers to build and maintain trading strategies. You will also be responsible for providing fully featurized datasets to statistical modeling researchers.

HRT does not have information siloes. You will be collaborating directly with our researchers and will be responsible for driving  the business forward through rigorous data analysis and delivery. You will also manage the full end-to-end pipeline from vendor downloads to trading-ready data. As an expert in one area, you will mentor junior data engineers, assisting and validating their work, and will partner with our sourcing team to identify optimal opportunities for data procurement. Furthermore, you will be responsible for ensuring high-quality service by implementing rigorous data checks and alerts.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain fully featurized datasets for statistical modeling research
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for a designated data domain
  • Provide technical support and guidance to researchers on vendor data and derived datasets
  • Mentor and direct junior data engineers, including performing code and data output validation
  • Partner with the sourcing team to identify and evaluate new data procurement opportunities
  • Analyze data to identify and improve alpha
  • Manage the full end-to-end data pipeline, from raw vendor ingestion to refined feature sets
  • Provide on-call support for data issues during normal business hours
  • Design and implement automated data quality checks and monitoring alerts

Qualifications

  • Strong programming skills (Python/R preferred) and proficiency in data science methodologies
  • 5+ years of professional experience in a specific data domain (e.g., alternative data, fundamentals, security reference, or economic data)
  • Proven track record of building alpha through detailed data analysis
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • Undergraduate degree in a STEM field

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Please be advised: Use of AI tools by an applicant during interviews or assessments is strictly prohibited, unless otherwise instructed or agreed upon. We employ various methods to evaluate the authenticity of candidate responses. If we determine that AI assistance was used by an applicant during an interview or an assessment, we reserve the right to immediately end the interview or assessment, disqualify the applicant’s candidacy and/or rescind any job offers extended.

You can review our Global Applicant Privacy Notice, which explains how we process applicant information.
