description: Il y a vingt ans, les premières sélections Les Composantes voyaient le jour. Une histoire née d’une soif d’indépendance et d’une passion pour le vintage. Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Responsable Réglementation et Conformité (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe Juridique. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). Le Responsable Réglementation et Conformité veille à ce que l'entreprise respecte l'ensemble des réglementations applicables à ses activités, produits et processus, tant au niveau national qu'international. Il garantit la conformité des collections (prêt-à-porter et accessoires, lifestyle et décoration/maison) avec les normes en vigueur, tout en intégrant les enjeux éthiques, environnementaux et sociaux sur l'ensemble des marques du groupe. Il pilote par ailleurs le dispositif de conformité corporate du groupe, en particulier la lutte anticorruption. Missions 1. Veille réglementaire et normative Assurer une veille constante sur les réglementations applicables : droit de la consommation, droit du travail, droit commercial, douanes, réglementation textile, REACH, sécurité produit, étiquetage, allégations environnementales (directive Empowering Consumers), protection des données Identifier les évolutions réglementaires susceptibles d'impacter l'activité de l'entreprise (France, UE, Royaume-Uni, États-Unis, pays de fabrication et de distribution) Informer les équipes internes des évolutions et les accompagner dans leur mise en œuvre 2. Conformité produit S'assurer que les produits respectent les exigences légales en matière de composition, traçabilité, étiquetage, sécurité, tests laboratoires, sur l'ensemble des catégories (textile, maroquinerie, bijoux, lifestyle, décoration/maison) Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes qualité, achats, design, développement produit et supply chain afin de garantir la bonne conduite des audits de conformité et des tests produits (substances réglementées, inflammabilité, solidité, sécurité des articles enfant…) 3. Conformité corporate et lutte anticorruption Piloter le dispositif de conformité à la loi Sapin II : cartographie des risques de corruption, code de conduite, dispositif d'alerte interne, procédures d'évaluation des tiers, formation des collaborateurs exposés Gérer le dispositif de recueil des signalements (lanceurs d'alerte) : réception, qualification, instruction et suivi, dans le respect de la confidentialité et des délais légaux Déployer et suivre les procédures de due diligence tiers (fournisseurs, intermédiaires, agents à l'international) Assurer le suivi des obligations liées au devoir de vigilance et au reporting de durabilité (CSRD), en lien avec les équipes RSE et Finance 4. Accompagnement des équipes et mise en conformité Rédiger ou actualiser les procédures internes et les différents cahiers des charges (produits, matières, fournitures) Former les collaborateurs aux enjeux réglementaires et de conformité (équipes design, production, marketing, supply chain, achats, finance, commerce) Aider à l'accompagnement par les équipes des fournisseurs dans la mise en conformité des produits et dans le respect des standards sociaux et environnementaux de l'entreprise Être le point de contact des équipes opérationnelles pour toute question de conformité, et savoir arbitrer entre exigence réglementaire et réalité business 5. Gestion des risques et reporting Mettre en place des plans de prévention ; animer et mettre à jour la cartographie des risques de conformité du groupe Suivre les indicateurs de conformité et établir un reporting régulier Gérer les situations liées à une non-conformité : rappels produits, litiges clients, contrôles DGCCRF, AFA, CNIL ou autorités étrangères Piloter les relations avec les conseils externes sur les sujets de conformité Requirements Formation supérieure en droit (Master 2 en droit des affaires, compliance, droit de la consommation ou équivalent) ; une certification compliance est un atout 6 à 10 ans d'expérience en conformité, en entreprise ou en cabinet, avec une expérience opérationnelle avérée du déploiement d'un dispositif Sapin II Une expérience dans le retail, le e-commerce ou les biens de consommation est fortement souhaitée, idéalement avec une exposition à la conformité produit textile et aux filières REP Maîtrise des réglementations clés : Sapin II, RGPD, droit de la consommation, devoir de vigilance, réglementation textile et sécurité produit Capacité à traduire la réglementation en process opérationnels simples, applicables par des équipes non juristes Rigueur, autonomie, sens de la confidentialité et solidité face à des situations sensibles Anglais courant indispensable, environnement de travail international Sézane recrute et valorise tous les talents, quels que soient votre genre, âge, nationalité, culture, croyances religieuses et orientations sexuelles. About AlphaSense: 

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. description:
Who We Are

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.

Senior Consultant with experience in Commerce ecosystems and technologies wanted to join our Business Services team 

The opportunity:

How consumers discover, evaluate and buy products is changing faster than most organisations can respond. AI-powered search, agentic commerce, generative product discovery and the collapse of the traditional funnel are reshaping commercial models across every sector. Most enterprise clients know something has shifted, few have a clear plan for what to do about it.

WPP Enterprise Solutions is building a commerce consulting practice to help clients navigate these shifts. We work with some of the world's most recognised brands, translating complex commercial challenges into actionable strategies, transformation roadmaps and delivery programmes. What makes this role different from a boutique or a SaaS provider is what sits around you: your consulting recommendations connect directly to creative, content, CX and commerce execution teams who bring them to life. Strategy doesn't end at a slide deck here.

We're looking for a Senior Consultant who can own projects and client relationships. Someone who takes an ambiguous brief, structures it independently, drives the strategic direction and ensures the quality of everything the team delivers. You'll lead client conversations, design and facilitate workshops, and be the person mid-to-senior client stakeholders trust to connect diagnostic findings to commercial action. You'll also play a key role in growing the practice, spotting extension opportunities within accounts, contributing to pitches and coaching more junior members of the team.

  • Perm 
  • London/Hybrid 
  • Travel to client site where required

What you’ll be doing:

Project Leadership & Delivery

  • Own medium-scale projects end-to-end: scope, quality, delivery timeline, and client relationship. Accountable for the strategic direction and the standard of output.
  • Lead the development of strategic recommendations across commerce transformation, AI discoverability (GEO/AEO), agentic commerce readiness, content strategy and channel optimisation - shaping the narrative, not just building the analysis.
  • Take ambiguous or loosely defined briefs and structure them into clear project plans with defined deliverables, milestones and resource requirements.
  • Build and codify delivery methodologies into repeatable, scalable frameworks the wider team can execute against.

Client Leadership:

  • Design and lead workshops, stakeholder interviews and co-creation sessions. You will be comfortable going off-script when the conversation requires it and steering senior client stakeholders toward actionable outcomes.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to mid-to-senior client contacts. You are the person they call when they need the thinking sharpened or the direction challenged.
    Anticipate and respond to client questions in a compelling and informed way. Own the client relationship day-to-day, identifying when senior escalation or support is needed.

Business Development:

  • Identify growth opportunities within existing accounts - spot the extension, the adjacent brief, the unasked question and work with senior leadership to convert them.
  • Contribute meaningfully to proposals and pitch responses: shaping the strategic approach, writing key sections, and presenting to prospective clients where appropriate.
  • Build client relationships that generate repeat work - not just deliver well, but leave clients wanting more.

Team & Practice Building:

  • Coach and develop Consultants on the team: Setting the quality bar on projects, giving direct feedback, and creating opportunities for junior team members to stretch.
  • This role may line-manage 1–2 team members, depending on team structure.
  • Drive practice IP development: reusable frameworks, case studies, proposition collateral and points of view that strengthen our market position and make selling easier.
  • Work across WPP's integrated network: connecting upstream consulting recommendations to downstream execution in content, CX and commerce.

What we want from you:

  • Extensive professional experience, with a strong track record in consulting, strategy or senior commercial/digital roles (ideally blending both)
  • Deep understanding of how commerce ecosystems work: You've either run a commerce operation (brand-side) or advised on one (agency/consulting-side). You understand how trading, content, category management, channel strategy and technology intersect in practice.
  • Working knowledge of AI discoverability: GEO, AEO, LLM-influenced discovery, AI assistants and conversational commerce. You can advise a Head of Digital or VP of eCommerce on what this shift means for their business and back it up with a credible action plan.
  • Proven ability to lead projects independently - you've managed scope, quality and client expectations without someone looking over your shoulder.
  • Strong strategic and analytical thinking: you can take a diagnostic output or a data-heavy assessment and turn it into a clear, commercially prioritised set of recommendations with a compelling narrative.
  • Excellent communication and executive presence - you're comfortable leading a room, running a workshop, and navigating a difficult client conversation with credibility.
  • Experience building methodology or practice IP: You've created frameworks, playbooks or delivery approaches that others have adopted and scaled.

Ideally you will have:

  • Brand-side experience in eCommerce, digital marketing or commercial leadership - you've lived the reality of managing a P&L, running a digital operation, or leading a commerce team. This perspective is what separates a genuine consultant from a presenter of slides.
  • Experience in at least two of: CPG/FMCG, Consumer health, Automotive, Retail, Telecom.
  • Change management or enablement experience: you've helped organisations adopt new operating models, not just designed them.
  • Line management or mentoring experience.

If you know some of this, even better:

  • Hands-on curiosity with AI tools LLMs, agentic platforms, or similar.
  • Experience with commerce technology (Shopify, SFCC, Commercetools, PIM/DAM systems).

What we can offer you:

  • The chance to shape a growing consulting practice your work will define methodology and propositions, not just execute someone else's.
  • Direct access to iconic enterprise clients and the opportunity to contribute to both proposition development and project delivery.
  • An integrated agency network where your consulting work connects to creative, content, CX and commerce teams who make the recommendations real.
  • A team culture that values intellectual honesty, pace and ownership.
  • London-based with flexible hybrid working and occasional client travel.
  • Training, development, and a clear path to Senior Consultant and beyond.

Permanent only
We offer a great benefits package including a discretionary bonus scheme, training opportunities, competitive pension, medical insurance, life assurance, social events, opportunities to buy and sell holidays, family friendly policies, discounts with hundreds of retailers and much more.

Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.

We lead with Heart, fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human-centric work flourish.
We empower your Brains for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
And we champion Courage, inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.

At  WPP Enterprise Solutions

WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernisation, connecting strategy directly to execution.  

Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX, work within a unified global operating unit across 40+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best-in-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. We have received distinction as a leader in Commerce Services and CX Strategy Consulting by the Forrester Wave™  

To find out more, visit enterprisesolutions.wpp.com and follow us on LinkedIn. 

WPP Enterprise Solutions is part of WPP, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel.

About WPP

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.

WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

description:
Who We Are

Lightning AI is the company behind PyTorch Lightning. Founded in 2019, we build an end-to-end platform for developing, training, and deploying AI systems—designed to take ideas from research to production with less friction.

Through our merger with Voltage Park, a neocloud and AI Factory, Lightning AI combines developer-first software with cost-efficient, large-scale compute. Teams get the tools they need for experimentation, training, and production inference, with security, observability, and control built in.

We serve solo researchers, startups, and large enterprises. Lightning AI operates globally with offices in New York City, San Francisco, Seattle, and London, and is backed by Coatue, Index Ventures, Bain Capital Ventures, and Firstminute.

The Way We Work

The people who thrive here are builders who move fast, communicate openly, take ownership, and continuously improve themselves, their teams, and our company. Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Move with Urgency: We move quickly, make thoughtful decisions, and keep momentum. We value action over perfection and learn by shipping.
  • Take Ownership: We own outcomes, not just our individual work. We make decisions that move the company forward and follow through.
  • Communicate Openly: We communicate directly, seek to understand, and create clarity for others. Honest conversations help us move faster together.
  • Build Great Teams: We lead by example, empower others, and create healthy teams where people can do their best work.
  • Raise the Bar: We're always improving ourselves. We learn from feedback, consistently challenge ourselves to grow, and focus on the work that matters most.
  • Think Long-Term: We design for what's next. We create scalable systems, simplify complexity, and use AI and automation to amplify our impact.
 

What We're Looking For

Lightning AI is seeking an experienced Senior Infrastructure Operations Engineer to help operate and scale the infrastructure behind one of the world's largest GPU fleets.

Our Infrastructure Operations team sits at the center of production reliability for Lightning's AI infrastructure. The team works across Linux, bare-metal servers, GPUs, networking, storage, provisioning, and cluster orchestration, serving as a critical technical escalation point when complex infrastructure issues arise.

What You'll Do

  • Operate and troubleshoot large-scale GPU and bare-metal infrastructure across Linux, compute, networking, storage, and cluster orchestration.
  • Serve as a technical escalation point for complex infrastructure issues, driving problems from initial investigation through resolution and root cause analysis.
  • Own operational workflows across the infrastructure lifecycle, including provisioning, configuration, validation, maintenance, remediation, and decommissioning.
  • Build automation and internal tooling that eliminates repetitive operational work and enables the infrastructure fleet to scale efficiently.
  • Identify recurring failure modes and partner with Infrastructure Engineering to build more reliable, repeatable, and automated systems.
  • Improve provisioning, monitoring, diagnostics, and operational processes across a rapidly growing infrastructure footprint.
  • Partner closely with Infrastructure Engineering, Network Engineering, Data Center Operations, Customer Experience, and Platform Engineering to resolve issues that cross team or system boundaries.
  • Participate in a distributed primary/secondary on-call rotation supporting production infrastructure.

What You'll Need

Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience operating and troubleshooting Linux-based production infrastructure at scale.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex infrastructure issues across compute, networking, storage, and operating systems.
  • Strong automation and scripting skills using Python, Go, Bash, Ansible, or similar tools.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, Slurm, or other cluster and workload orchestration systems.
  • Experience using monitoring, observability, and telemetry systems to diagnose and troubleshoot production infrastructure.
  • Strong systems and networking fundamentals, with a track record of owning production issues through resolution.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and collaborating across engineering, operations, and customer-facing teams.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience troubleshooting, provisioning, or operating bare-metal server infrastructure.
  • Experience operating or troubleshooting GPU, HPC, or other high-performance compute infrastructure.
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA GPUs, DCGM, InfiniBand, RoCE/RDMA, NVLink, or high-speed data center networking.
  • Experience with hardware management and provisioning technologies such as PXE, BMC, IPMI, Redfish, or iDRAC.
  • Experience with distributed or high-performance storage systems such as VAST, Ceph, GPFS, or WEKA.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code, configuration management, or GitOps workflows.

 

Compensation

 

We are committed to offering competitive compensation that reflects the value each team member brings to our mission. Final offers are based on factors such as experience, skills, geographic location, and role expectations. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package for eligible roles includes a discretionary bonus, a meaningful equity component, and comprehensive benefits.

The anticipated annual base salary range for this role is:
£116,000—£128,000 GBP

Benefits and Perks

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support our employees’ health, well-being, and long-term success:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Meaningful Equity: RSUs that give employees a stake in the company's long-term success.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) matching (U.S.) and pension contributions (U.K.).
  • Flexible Time Off: Unlimited PTO, company holidays, and floating holidays to support work-life balance.
  • Company-Wide Winter Break: Two weeks of company closure each winter to disconnect and recharge.
  • Paid Parental & Family Leave: Paid leave to support you and your family through life's important moments.
  • Professional Development: Annual learning and development allowance to support your professional growth.
  • Wellness Benefits: Wellness and work-from-home stipends to support your physical and mental well-being.
  • Sabbatical Program: Four weeks of paid sabbatical leave after four years of service.
  • Flexible Work: Flexible schedules and a hybrid work model for our office-based teams.
  • In-Office Meals: Complimentary meals at our office hubs.

Benefits may vary by location, team, and role.

 

At Lightning AI, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and create better products. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We are dedicated to building a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute to their fullest potential.

description:
Firmus Technologies

Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific.

Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. 

At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally.

 

Firmus AI Cloud

Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers.

It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale.

 

Why Firmus?

As an NVIDIA Cloud and Engineering partner in Asia Pacific, you will gain skills, experience, and exposure across the AI industry and be part of shaping what this industry looks like for decades to come.

We are founder-led, not a big corporate. Decisions happen fast, our leaders are accessible, and there's minimum bureaucracy between you and the work. Ownership comes early. Whatever your role, you will have a direct line to outcomes, helping shape how the business grows as we scale nationally across a long-term, large-scale roadmap. 

Work alongside founders and experts in AI infrastructure, energy systems and next-generation compute.

What we build here has impact beyond the business. Our AI Factories are designed to operate as assets to the energy grid to actively strengthen the communities and regions they operate in rather than drawing from them.

We connect people, data, and processes in one intuitive, feature-rich solution, empowering every team—from Finance to HR—to build, adapt, and align strategic plans in real time. Founded in 2019, Pigment is one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies globally. Industry leaders like Unilever, Snowflake, Siemens, and DPD use Pigment daily to make more informed decisions and confidently navigate any scenario. With a team of 600+ across Paris, London, New York, Toronto, San Francisco and Austin, we've raised nearly $400M from top-tier investors and were named a Visionary in the 2024 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Financial Planning Software. At Pigment, we take smart risks, celebrate bold ideas, and challenge the status quo—all while working as one team. If you're driven by innovation and ready to make an impact at scale, we’d love to hear from you. The opportunity We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer profile who will design and implement the Pigment infrastructure for tomorrow. Pigment is a technically challenging platform. It calculates and synchronizes large datasets that must be updated in real-time. Data comes from client models that can be up to billions of rows. This data can be pivoted, transformed, and aggregated on-demand through our formula engine while rendering live on our front end. Here are the challenges to be tackled as a Senior Platform Engineer: Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. In particular, ensure that the infrastructure scales in and out according to the platform usage. Secure high availability and redundancy of the Pigment platform. Ensure that the platform’s performance and correctness are monitored accordingly, spread observability best practices across the engineering team. Participate in incident response. Accompany Pigment geographical expansion as the company grows and we sign clients overseas. Work with our security team on the implementation of their roadmap when related to infrastructure and development pipelines (code repository, credentials management, ...) Continuously chase inefficiencies within our development practices and pipelines. Seek improvement and automation wherever possible. Drive change across the software engineering team. In addition to Platform responsibilities, we expect you to contribute to software development activities. This is not limited to scripting and automations - we expect to you to be fully capable of reading and writing code. We believe Senior Platform Engineers should collaborate closely with software engineers, fostering a shared understanding of day-to-day challenges, rather than operating in separate teams. Last but not least, you will not be alone! You will be part of an SRE team. Our Engineering team Our Engineering team is responsible for developing our SaaS platform and building a comprehensive and user-friendly product. Pigment engineers participate in the entire application development lifecycle, focusing on design, coding, and keeping the production platform up and running. They can be specialized, but there is no strict separation between the infrastructure, backend, and the frontend. We value user-centricity and pragmatism: we choose the most relevant tools for the problem we have to solve, understanding the strengths and constraints of each technology. Our engineering culture also values curiosity, humility, trust, ownership and team spirit. Technical stack: Kubernetes (GKE, hosted on Google Cloud Platform): hosting all our infrastructure components except some PostgreSQL hosts, hosted on Google Cloud SQL Terraform: all our infrastructure is managed via this infrastructure as code (creation of GKE clusters, Google Cloud SQL databases, GCS buckets, IAM permissions...) Databases: PostgreSQL (CloudSQL and CloudNativePG), SingleStore, ElasticSearch RabbitMQ: queuing system Temporal.io: workflow automation platform Others: ArgoCD, Istio, Vault, Github, Docker (for local development) Backend: Microservices written in C# ASP.NET Core 8 (running exclusively on Linux) & Golang Frontend: React + Typescript, Jest, Cypress, Vite... Who you are More than knowledge of a specific cloud provider, language, or automation framework, we are looking for great engineering skills: the ability to translate product requirements into an elegant and simple architecture, and then make sure our product runs well on it. In any case, you have: Experience as a software engineer & Platform Engineer. Hands on coding is a must for this role. Experience with a container orchestration platform (Kubernetes is a plus) Experience with a public cloud provider, GCP is a plus Proven experience in software developments with languages such as C#, Java, C++, Golang, Rust, JavaScript, Python, or Ruby (this list is not exhaustive). Experience with observability tools (e.g. Datadog, Prometheus, ELK, Jaeger...) Great team spirit with a problem-solving attitude. A good dose of humility and the willingness to grow (no matter your seniority!). title: Senior Platform Engineer

description: Building the Future of Open Finance Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work. The team Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. We’re hiring a Product Manager with deep UX and interaction design expertise to build social experiences around investing and trading at Kraken. You should be comfortable designing flows yourself, building interactive prototypes, and working through interaction details with designers and engineers. You’ll also own the product decisions: which customer problem to solve, what to ship first, and how to measure whether the experience improved. The opportunity Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation. Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind. Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria. Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute. Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action. Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first. Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences. Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next. What you bring Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch. Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed. Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states. Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design. Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement. Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. Our commitment Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. description: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions About the Role We are looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager – Advanced Technology Programs to lead large-scale, strategic technology and R&D programs involving multiple technical disciplines, internal teams and external partners. You will operate at the intersection of technology, engineering and program execution, turning ambitious technical objectives into structured and executable programs. You will coordinate programs involving disciplines such as quantum physics, integrated photonics, semiconductor technologies, electronics, optics, hardware engineering, software and algorithms, while ensuring alignment between technical performance, schedule, resources, budget and contractual commitments. We are particularly interested in candidates who have managed large and technically complex programs in demanding engineering environments such as space, aerospace, defense or semiconductors, where successful delivery requires coordinating multidisciplinary teams, suppliers, industrial partners, research organizations and institutional stakeholders across several countries. This is a senior individual contributor / program leadership position requiring both technical credibility and strong execution capabilities. You will not be expected to be the scientific expert on every topic, but you must be able to understand complex technical dependencies, challenge assumptions, structure decisions and create the conditions for engineering teams to deliver. Key responsabilities ** Lead Complex Technology Projects Take end-to-end ownership of strategic R&D and technology projects, from initial framing through development, integration, validation and final delivery. Translate high-level scientific, product or business ambitions into clear program objectives, work packages, milestones, interfaces and measurable deliverables. Develop and maintain integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, resources, budget, dependencies and critical paths. Establish program governance and ensure effective decision-making across technical teams and senior stakeholders. Monitor progress against milestones and proactively identify deviations, bottlenecks and dependencies requiring management attention. Drive recovery plans when projects deviate from their original objectives, including prioritization, resource reallocation, scope adjustment or technical replanning. ** Manage Technical complexity & interfaces Coordinate multidisciplinary teams spanning quantum physics, photonics, semiconductor technologies, optics, electronics, mechanical engineering, systems engineering, software and algorithms. Work closely with technical leads to identify critical interfaces and dependencies between subsystems and workstreams. Challenge project assumptions and ensure that technical decisions are translated into clear consequences for performance, schedule, cost and risk. Support the transition from research and scientific proof-of-concept to engineering development, prototyping, integration, qualification and demonstrators. Ensure that technical maturity, integration readiness and project risks are visible and understood at program level. ** Coordinate Internal & External Stakeholders Act as a central coordination point between Quandela teams, industrial partners, suppliers, research institutions and institutional stakeholders. Lead technical and programmatic exchanges involving stakeholders with different scientific, engineering and business perspectives. Coordinate activities across multiple teams, organizations, sites and countries, ensuring clear ownership and effective information flow. Manage expectations and commitments with external partners while protecting Quandela's technical, contractual and strategic interests. Prepare and lead program reviews, steering committees and executive-level project updates. ** Risk, Budget & Delivery Management Establish and maintain structured risk and opportunity management, including technical, schedule, supply-chain, financial and organizational risks. Own or contribute to program budgets, resource forecasts and capacity planning. Define and monitor relevant KPIs covering delivery, technical maturity, cost, schedule and risk. Anticipate critical-path issues and implement mitigation plans before they impact major milestones. Create a strong culture of accountability, transparency and fact-based decision-making across programs. ** Governance, contracts & compliance Ensure high-quality program documentation, traceability and reporting. Coordinate contractual deliverables and reporting for strategic partnerships and publicly funded programs where applicable. Work with relevant internal stakeholders on IP, confidentiality, export-control, security and contractual matters. Contribute to improving Quandela's project and program management methodologies as the organization scales. Requirements Education You have graduated from a top-tier engineering school or university in engineering, physics or another relevant scientific or technical discipline. A PhD in physics, photonics, quantum technologies, semiconductor technologies or a related engineering field is a strong asset, particularly when combined with substantial industrial program-management experience. Experience You bring approximately 10+ years of professional experience, including significant responsibility for complex technology or engineering programs. You have demonstrated experience leading large-scale, multidisciplinary projects with significant technical complexity, multiple interfaces and demanding delivery objectives. Experience in one or several of the following industries is particularly relevant: Space / aerospace Defense Semiconductors / microelectronics Advanced photonics or optics Complex scientific instrumentation Other high-tech environments combining hardware, software and advanced engineering You have worked with multidisciplinary and international stakeholders, including engineering teams, scientists, suppliers, industrial partners, research institutions and/or public organizations. You can demonstrate concrete examples of programs for which you managed significant scope, budget, resources, milestones, risks and external dependencies. Technical & Program Management Capabilities You have sufficient technical depth to understand complex engineering discussions, challenge project assumptions and identify critical technical dependencies without replacing subject-matter experts. You are comfortable managing projects from early-stage R&D through engineering development, prototyping, integration and validation. You have strong command of project/program management practices including WBS, planning, critical-path management, risk management, resource planning, budget management, change management and project governance. Experience with PMI/PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or hybrid methodologies is valued, but demonstrated delivery experience matters more than certification alone. Experience with publicly funded, governmental or collaborative R&D programs is an advantage. Previous quantum-computing experience is not mandatory. Experience in quantum technologies, photonics or semiconductor technologies would nevertheless be a strong asset. Leadership & Mindset You combine a strong engineering mindset with the ability to operate at program and strategic level. You are comfortable challenging senior technical stakeholders while maintaining constructive and fact-based discussions. You know how to bring structure to environments where technical uncertainty is high and not all answers are available at the beginning of a project. You can distinguish between issues requiring deep technical investigation and those requiring pragmatic decisions to maintain momentum. You communicate effectively with both highly specialized technical teams and executive stakeholders. You are comfortable operating in an international, multidisciplinary and rapidly growing deeptech environment. Professional fluency in English is required. Benefits Flexible working environment, with the position primarily based at our Massy (Paris-Saclay) office to support close collaboration with the teams. Profit-sharing and a company savings plan. Annual sustainable mobility bonus for eco-friendly transport (e-bike, electric car). Fully covered health insurance (Alan). Referral program (€1,000 for a junior and €2,000 for an experienced candidate) Subsidy for gym membership and sports activities (Gymlib). Meal subsidies (Swile). Process Talent Acquisition Interview (45') Hiring Managers Interviews (45' - 60') Reference checks Technical discussion and presentation of previous technical project management work Offer Beyond That: At Quandela, we value intellectual diversity, curiosity and initiative. If you're passionate about quantum algorithms, fault-tolerant quantum computing and the future of large-scale quantum applications, we'd love to hear from you, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. description:
About Faire

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Senior SDR, Enterprise Brand Partnerships
Location: London, UK
OTE: £56,000–£77,000 per year + equity + benefits

This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

About this role

Faire’s quality, depth, and breadth of supply is one of our strongest value propositions to retailers, and our Enterprise Brand Partnerships team plays a critical role in bringing strategic, high-value brands onto the platform. As a Senior SDR, you will directly contribute to Faire’s growth by helping scale our enterprise supply strategy and building relationships with brands that will shape the future of our marketplace.We are looking for a strategic and highly motivated sales professional who can independently manage complex outbound prospecting motions, identify high-potential partnership opportunities, and help drive pipeline growth for our Enterprise Account Executive team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments, enjoys solving problems creatively, and is excited to contribute beyond their individual pipeline through collaboration, mentorship, and process improvement initiatives.Faire’s goal is to become the default platform for brands to grow their wholesale business and for retailers to discover products for their stores. As we continue to scale, there will be significant opportunities for ownership, impact, and career growth.

What you’ll do 

  • Build and execute strategic outbound prospecting motions to engage high-value and enterprise-level brands
  • Prospect, identify, and prioritize brands that are a strong fit for Faire’s retailer ecosystem and long-term marketplace strategy
  • Drive qualified pipeline generation through a mix of cold calls, warm outreach, email campaigns, social selling, and creative prospecting strategies
  • Customize outreach and discovery conversations based on brand pain points, category dynamics, and business goals
  • Partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives to strategically manage territories, prioritize opportunities, and improve conversion outcomes
  • Leverage Salesforce, reporting tools, and sales engagement platforms to track pipeline health, monitor pacing to goals, and optimize outreach strategy
  • Identify workflow inefficiencies, contribute ideas for process improvement, and support broader team initiatives
  • Act as a collaborative partner and trusted resource across the SDR and AE organization by sharing best practices, insights, and learnings
  • Have opportunities to grow into more strategic sales, leadership, enablement, or cross-functional roles within the company

Qualifications

Must Haves

  • A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional working experience
  • Fluent in French and English
  • Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to confidently lead prospect conversations 
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills with the ability to manage a large book of prospective accounts
  • Ability to tailor outreach strategies and messaging based on customer pain points and market context
  • Strong business acumen and curiosity around retail, ecommerce, and marketplace dynamics
  • Experience leveraging data, dashboards, and reporting tools to inform outreach strategy and identify opportunities or gaps
  • Motivated, curious, action-oriented, and proactive in fast-moving environments with evolving priorities
  • Passionate about Faire’s mission and helping entrepreneurs and brands grow their businesses
  • Collaborative mindset with a willingness to contribute to team growth, mentorship, and process improvement

Nice to Haves

  • 1-2 years+ of retail or customer-facing work experience
  • Experience with Salesforce, Salesloft, Looker, or similar sales/reporting platforms
  • Enterprise or strategic account prospecting experience
  • Strong cold calling and objection handling experience
  • Experience working in SaaS, marketplace, ecommerce, or startup environments
  • Retail, merchandising, wholesale, or small business experience
  • Entrepreneurial mindset and desire to help shape a growing sales organization 

Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. 

Why you’ll love working at Faire

  • Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.
  • Equipped to scale: We invest in what matters, including the latest enterprise AI tools, to help you work smarter and get more out of every day.
  • Best in class: Our team is full of sharp, kind, and generous colleagues who care about their craft and about helping you grow in yours.
  • Real rewards. Competitive pay, equity, and comprehensive benefits designed to support your life inside and outside of work.
  • Belonging: We're intentional about building an environment where every Faire employee has equal access to opportunities, growth, and success.

Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog.

Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs.  To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form (https://bit.ly/faire-form)

Privacy

For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys. You’re always looking for new opportunities to learn about our customers, the market, competitors, technology, etc. Customer Focused - You start with the customer and work back whilst understanding that solutions have to work for our business Outcome focused - You can define what success looks like and measure progress towards it A clear communicator - You’re capable of explaining things regardless of whether it’s to a software engineer, salesperson, customer support agent or CEO What we can offer you As well as a competitive salary of circa £100,000 per annum, we offer a comprehensive benefits package, covering a variety of areas, both professional and personal. These benefits include: Hybrid working style, with the expectation of two days in the office (with a great City of London office base!) Family friendly benefits including paid parental leave policies An extensive health insurance policy for you, with an option to add your family members A workplace pension with Hargreaves Lansdown Life insurance of 4 x your salary Weekly self-development time to spend exploring your professional development interests 25 days of annual leave (plus bank holidays), your birthday off, and an opportunity to buy up to 5 days annual leave per year A holistic wellbeing support plan encompassing a variety of offerings to assist you. We provide you with a monthly £50 allowance to fund activities to best support your wellbeing as well as workshops and training to provide tools and guidance. Additionally, there is a wide-ranging employee assistance programme available to advise on personal, family or financial matters, and fun social events during the year. This role combines sharp analytical capability with leadership, directly guiding our SEA intern to support wider team growth. This position is permanent and located in Munich. WHAT YOU'LL DO Own the execution and optimisation of performance campaigns across Google, Bing, Criteo, YouTube, and emerging LLM-based advertising platforms Steer monthly budgets of up to seven figures, focusing on profitability and contribution-margin steering rather than pure top-line metrics Act as a strategic sparring partner to the Team Lead Paid Media on highly complex operational and strategic initiatives Lead and mentor the SEA intern, managing their capacity and project allocation to maximise team impact Drive AI-based automation, bidding setups, and continuous testing roadmaps to unlock incremental channels and growth Collaborate with Analytics and Tech teams to ensure data excellence, robust conversion tracking, and high-quality product feeds Deliver insight-driven performance reporting and strategic recommendations to senior stakeholders YOU COME WITH 5+ years of hands-on SEA experience with deep expertise in Google Ads, as well as experience with Bing, Criteo, and YouTube Proven track record of independently managing seven-figure monthly budgets in an e-commerce environment Strong background in profitability steering, budget planning, internalised bidding, or contribution-margin optimisation Strategic mindset with the ability to translate high-level business goals into actionable channel roadmaps as well as high operational excellence and attention to detail, maintaining flawless account structures and data tracking Challenger mentality with intrinsic motivation to lead complex projects and proactively introduce AI and automation features Experience or strong aptitude for guiding, mentoring, or functionally supervising junior team members Full professional fluency in English; German language skills are a plus WHY WESTWING If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it. At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living. Here is what you can look forward to: A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone A flexible hybrid setup with 3 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen Work-from-anywhere opportunities for up to 4 weeks per year - as fresh perspectives spark bold ideas 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), and 20% Family & Friends discount on Westwing Collection, plus special-occasion vouchers Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Movie Nights and Oktoberfest to Summer & Winter Parties ABOUT US Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Westwing’s team works together on its shared purpose to “Excite people to create homes that unlock the full beauty of life”. Founded in 2011, Westwing is headquartered in Munich and went public on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange in October 2018. Our team is a diverse group of professionals aiming for high performance, working together at a fast pace in an inspiring, international and informal environment that enables you to grow your career while working with a brand and products our customers love. We’re made up of passionate people who are creative enough to disrupt the status quo, brave enough to fail and smart enough to win. So come, be part of the “wow, you work at Westwing?” crowd. Our mission doesn’t stop to inspire only your design choices, it continues to embrace an inclusive lifestyle filled with respect to everyone’s uniqueness, cultural differences and equal opportunity. description: Lemonway is a licensed payment institution at the heart of Europe’s new digital economy. We secure payments for crowdfunding platforms, the collaborative economy, marketplaces and online retailers, with a strong commitment to fighting fraud and protecting funds. Regulated by the ACPR and benefiting from the European passport in 29 countries, Lemonway is based in Paris and Hamburg and brings together 150 multicultural and committed Lemonheroes. More than 400 marketplaces trust us. We manage 1.4 million user wallets and have raised €50 million from Breega, Speedinvest and Toscafund. Profitable for the past four years and growing by 25% in 2025, Lemonway aims to remain one of Europe’s leading payment providers through healthy and sustainable growth. About the Team We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer for the Account Tribe, who build a critical part of our platform powering the compliance experience across channels. You will be led by John, the Engineering Manager of the Tribe, and work closely with 6 engineers across 2 squads : Comply, and Manage. Through this role, you will drive the enhancement of our platform by specifying, implementing, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting customer-facing services. You will also lead API integrations with third-party compliance vendors and implement regulatory compliance rules to meet regulatory requirements. This role combines technical craftsmanship, teamwork and product mindset for a Tribe that is central to both current and future projects for Lemonway. Join us to architect a resilient, unified platform built to seamlessly adapt to tomorrow's regulatory landscape. Your responsibilities Technical craftsmanship Design and deliver scalable, complex features that can evolve with the right trade-off between code quality and time spent Lead code and architecture reviews, actively enforcing and shaping the Tribe’s best practices and architectural decisions Drive continuous improvement: stay updated on the latest ecosystem trends, experiment with new patterns, and actively mentors peers to elevate the Tribe’s engineering standards Domain ownership Take strong ownership of the products we develop, and contribute to all parts of the development cycle from specifying to solving issues that our clients are facing in production Deep dive into our complex payment ecosystem. Ask tough questions, challenge the status quo, and leverage your architectural expertise together with domain knowledge to build resilient solutions Understand the “why” behind the “what”: bridge the gap between technical implementation and business value, ensuring our payment flows directly drive Lemonway’s operational success and client satisfaction Team player Collaborate closely with software, QA and infrastructure engineers to solve technical challenges, as well as product managers for feature development Act as a technical communicator: translate complex architectural decisions into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders Participate actively in our hybrid setup with people at the office, at home, and nearshore Strike the right balance between independent problem-solving and guiding teammates, whilst being solutions oriented in your approach You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, building robust and scalable applications You have deep architectural knowledge and proven hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD), Hexagonal architecture, Event-Driven Architecture, and Command Query Responsibility Segregation (CQRS) You have a solid grasp of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles, and a proven track record of designing, building and operating micro services-based architectures You possess excellent communication skills, enabling you to drive technical consensus and collaborate effectively across teams You actively leverage AI tools in your ways of working You are familiar with our modular technical stack based on NestJS (TypeScript), MongoDB, and RabbitMQ running on AWS You have practical experience in building CI/CD pipelines and using Terraform for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) You are fluent in French and you are comfortable working in English, which is a strong asset given our international environment (Nice to have) Knowledge of KYC and compliance topics in a regulated description:
We are looking for a Python Senior Software Engineer to join the ATP team in Application Platform Domain.

As a Senior Software Engineer, your mission will be to work on designing and delivering essential components that empower Doctolib teams to build robust and scalable services. You will be working in a feature team developing the chassis, archetypes, business-agnostic services, cross-cutting concerns and Claude Plugins.

You will be working in a platform feature team developing the Python and Java/Kotlin chassis, project archetypes, business-agnostic services, cross-cutting concerns (resilience, security, observability…) and Claude Plugins, used by more than 60 services across Doctolib.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib involves building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients. We work in feature teams in an agile environment, while collaborating with product, design, and business teams.

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define and implement features to improve the Doctolib platform
  • Take a leading role within the team and contribute to establishing a technical vision that ensures the performance, security, and usability of the platform, taking into account the future needs and the high scalability needs
  • Bring your expertise and experiences to help us continuously improve the way we implement, test, and monitor high-quality features
  • Improving the performance of key features implemented in Python, sometimes completely challenging the status quo
  • Taking leadership on delivering roadmap items (together with the team)
  • Contributing to establishing a technical vision and co-drive the creation of the roadmap for next quarters

About our tech environment

  • Our solutions are built on a single fully cloud-native platform that supports web and mobile app interfaces, multiple languages, and is adapted to the country and healthcare specialty requirements. To address these challenges, we are modularizing our platform run in a distributed architecture through reusable components. 
  • Our stack is composed of Rails, TypeScript, Java, Python, Kotlin, Swift, and React Native.
  • We leverage AI ethically across our products to empower patients and health professionals. Discover our AI vision here!

Who you are

Before you read on, if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

  • You are proactive, curious, collaborative and eager to learn
  • You are primarily a backend engineer with expert knowledge of Python 
  • You have a solid understanding of web technologies and software development life cycle
  • You have a “user first” mindset and want to build a product focused on bringing value to its users, through secure, well-tested and pragmatic code
  • You are fluent in English

Now it would be fantastic if you

  • have experience with Kafka and Kubernetes
  • have experience with ADK and ML libraries
  • have experience with Java or Kotlin

What we offer

  • Free comprehensive health insurance for you and your children
  • Parent Care Program: additional leave on top of the legal parental leave
  • Free mental health and coaching services through our partner Moka.care
  • For caregivers and workers with disabilities, a package including an adaptation of the remote policy, extra days off for medical reasons, and psychological support
  • Work from abroad for up to 10 days per year thanks to our flexibility days policy
  • Up to 14 days of RTT
  • A subsidy from the work council to refund part of the membership to a sport club or a creative class 
  • Lunch voucher with Swile card

The interview process 

  • Recruiter Interview 
  • Feature Building Interview 
  • System Design Interview
  • Behavioral Interview
  • At least one reference check

Job details

  • Permanent position
  • Full Time 
  • Location: Levallois
  • Hybrid work setup (up to 2 remote days per week)
  • Start date: As soon as possible

 

If you would like to find out more about tech life at Doctolib, feel free to read our latest Medium blog articles! 

At Doctolib, we are committed to improving access to healthcare for everyone. This translates into our recruitment process. We evaluate candidates based solely on qualifications and motivation, without any form of discrimination.

The more diverse ideas are heard, the more our product will truly improve healthcare for all. You are welcome to apply to Doctolib, regardless of your gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability.

To ensure equal opportunities, we invite you to exclude personal information (e.g. pictures, age) from your applications. If you require any accommodation, please let us know for support during the hiring process. 

Join us in building the healthcare we all dream of!

description: Was dich erwartet Fullstack-Entwicklung: Du entwickelst anspruchsvolle Java- und Webanwendungen im Front- und Backend – sowohl in modernen Spring-Umgebungen als auch im Jakarta EE Umfeld. Dabei bringst du deine Erfahrung aktiv in Kundenprojekte ein und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Kunden passende, nachhaltige Lösungen. Brückenbauer zwischen alter und neuer Java-Welt: Du kennst sowohl gewachsene Enterprise-Anwendungslandschaften und klassische Jakarta EE Architekturen als auch moderne Spring-, Cloud- und Microservice-Architekturen. Du verstehst die Stärken und Herausforderungen beider Welten und kannst bestehende Anwendungen und Architekturen schrittweise in moderne, zukunftsfähige Lösungen überführen. Architektur & Modernisierung: Du denkst nicht nur in Technologien, sondern in nachhaltigen Architekturen. Du analysierst bestehende Systeme, erkennst Modernisierungspotenziale und entwickelst Strategien, wie sich gewachsene Anwendungen sinnvoll weiterentwickeln lassen – ohne dabei funktionierende Lösungen unnötig über Bord zu werfen. Qualität & Engineering: Clean Code, Test Driven Development und DevOps gehören für dich zum professionellen Software Engineering und sind fester Bestandteil deiner täglichen Arbeit. Technologie & Innovation: Du interessierst dich für aktuelle Technologien, Architekturen und Trends und bewertest deren sinnvollen Einsatz. Gleichzeitig weißt du, dass moderne Softwareentwicklung im Enterprise-Umfeld häufig auf bestehenden Systemen aufbaut und nicht jede Lösung bei null beginnt. Problemlösung: Du analysierst komplexe technische Herausforderungen, optimierst bestehende Lösungen und findest pragmatische Wege, Legacy-Systeme mit modernen Technologien zu verbinden. Kollaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit Kollegen und anderen Teams zusammen und bringst dein technisches Know-how aktiv ein, um gemeinsam die bestmögliche Lösung für unsere Kunden zu entwickeln. Beraterrolle: Du bist nicht nur Entwickler, sondern auch technischer Berater. Du verstehst die Anforderungen unserer Kunden, hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze und unterstützt sie dabei, ihre Anwendungen und Architekturen nachhaltig weiterzuentwickeln. Weiterentwicklung: Du hast die Möglichkeit, dich durch praxisorientierte Trainings – insbesondere in Softwarearchitektur, Modernisierung und Cloud-Technologien – sowie durch den regelmäßigen Erfahrungsaustausch in unseren Gilden fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Was du mitbringst Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Fullstack-Entwicklung und hast einen starken Backend-Schwerpunkt in Java, gern ergänzt durch Kotlin oder Python. About Mirakl:

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl’s operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

With dual headquarters in Boston and Paris, Mirakl helps a global ecosystem of 450+ marketplaces (B2C and B2B) and a network of over 100k third-party marketplace sellers. Brands like Macy’s, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information, visit www.mirakl.com.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

Solution Consultant Intern — Mirakl Connect

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll be part of our EMEA Solution Consulting team led by Jonathan D'Elissagaray, Director of Solution Consulting. The team consists of two Solution Consultants focused on Mirakl Connect, working alongside four Platform Consultants covering B2B customers across Southern Europe and the Middle East. Together, you'll be helping sellers successfully onboard and grow through the Mirakl Connect ecosystem.
 
About Mirakl Connect
Mirakl Connect is Mirakl’s ecosystem platform, connecting marketplace operators and sellers to simplify partnerships, onboarding, and growth. Trusted by leading brands such as Macy’s and Lacoste, Mirakl Connect helps sellers discover new marketplace opportunities while enabling marketplace teams to efficiently onboard and manage their seller ecosystem at scale.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Support and progressively take ownership of end-to-end seller onboarding on Mirakl Connect, starting with simpler cases and building towards greater autonomy.
  • Guide sellers through key onboarding steps and deliver clear enablement sessions tailored to audiences with varying levels of technical knowledge.
  • Develop expertise in Catalog Transformer — Mirakl's AI-based catalogue management product — and support sellers in troubleshooting and optimising their catalogues.
  • Contribute to scaling onboarding by creating and improving documentation, guides, and internal content, and by identifying opportunities for process and reporting automation.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Support, and Data Science/AI teams, capturing feedback from onboarding activities to continuously improve the seller experience.
 

3. What You'll Bring to the Role

  • Currently enrolled in a Master's programme (M1 or M2) at a business school, engineering school, or equivalent institution, available for a six-month internship from January 2027
  • At least one previous internship or corporate experience, ideally in an enterprise environment

  • Curious and proactive, with a genuine interest in AI and a willingness to use it practically, including for troubleshooting AI-based products
  • Organised and able to manage multiple priorities effectively in a fast-paced environment
